entry.question: What certifications and accreditations does your company hold?
entry.answer: We are CMMC Level 2 certified and ISO 9001:2015 registered, reflecting our commitment to cybersecurity and quality management on defense and aerospace contracts. Our certifications are maintained through annual third party audits and are reviewed whenever our scope of work changes.

entry.question: How do you handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI)?
entry.answer: All CUI is processed, stored, and transmitted within a compliant enclave built to NIST SP 800-171 controls. Access is restricted to authorized personnel on a need to know basis, and every system handling CUI is included in our continuous monitoring and incident response program.

entry.question: What facility clearance level and program experience do you have?
entry.answer: Our facility holds a Secret level facility clearance through the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency, and our team has supported avionics, systems integration, and sustainment programs for DoD and prime aerospace customers. Contact us to discuss teaming opportunities or the clearance requirements for an upcoming program.
